title: Expression Reference
content:
::= ('||' )* ::= ('&&' )* ::= ( )* ::= (('+' | '-') )* ::= (('*' | '/' | '%') )* ::= ['-' | '!'] ::= ['as' ] ::= ( ('.' )*) | ::= ['[' ']'] ::= ('(' ')') | ('new' '[' ']') | ::= ['[' ']'] ::= | | 'length' The basic expression is an arrangement of operators, function calls, and variables chained together in such a way to do some work. These operations follow the rules of precedence to determine which gets executed first. Examples: ; Add 2 to the value of 4 times 10 (result is 42) 2 + 4 * 10
; Add 2 to 4, and multiply by 10 (result is 60) (2 + 4) * 10
; Call a function and get a property from the results MyFunction().MyProperty
; Get the first element in the array returned by the function after a cast (MyVariable as MyObject).MyFunction()[0]
